description: Returns a Recycled Action Plan Section

id.description: Unique identifier for this deleted Action Plan section.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this section was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this section was soft-deleted.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this deleted section belonged to.

position.description: Ordinal position this section held within its Action Plan before deletion.

title.description: Display title of the deleted section.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this section was last updated before deletion.
